title: ASARS Industrial-ROS Profile v0.1-draft
description: ASARS payload extension for factory robotics and ROS-based industrial systems. Draft — requires review from ROS + functional-safety practitioners before publication.

industrial_context.description: Industrial cell and safety context at the ROS command demarcation point.

ros_topic.description: Fully qualified topic identifying actuator or subsystem.

command_type.description: Semantic command class (e.g. move, stop, engage, release) — extend per deployment dictionary.

hitl_required.description: Whether human-in-the-loop was required for this class of command.

hitl_authorized_by.description: Operator or role identifier when HITL authorized.

command_disposition.description: Domain result of the command path. Map to core outcome: executed→allowed; blocked→blocked; escalated→blocked (pending) or allowed (cleared) per policy.

outcome.description: Core ASARS policy result at observation time.

notes: Validate joint state / velocity payloads and PLC hash fields with integrators before freezing. Acknowledge reviewer(s) in README when promoted from draft.
